resources.name: Spin-polarized DFT code with HSE06 functional (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT, GPAW, SIESTA)

access.notes: Any open-source DFT package supporting HSE06 and spin-polarized calculations. The paper used FHI-aims; these alternatives produce equivalent total energies for the same functional and basis-set quality.

resources.notes: Public open-source DFT codes are sufficient; no proprietary license is required.

resources.name: Cubic rock-salt MnO crystal structure

access.notes: Standard rock-salt structure (space group Fm-3m) with lattice constant a = 4.430 Å. The 2×2×2 supercell (64 atoms) can be generated by the agent from the primitive cell.

resources.notes: No external download needed; geometry is reconstructed from the known lattice parameter.
